answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond in a harbor escrow before it can transact. The bond is released only after the agent completes a verifiable stretch of useful work, so a sybil operator must fund each fake identity separately. Like water carving karst, honest activity slowly erodes the lock while abuse triggers slashing, and an echo of the fraud follows the operator's other identities through shared stake fingerprints. Creating ten thousand sock puppets then costs ten thousand bonds, turning a cheap flood into an expensive trickle.
